notes.title: Thrillgate - Version 1.1
notes.notes:
CHANGELOG


 Fixed a bug in chapter 1 related to the mail box
 General fix for Mike character
 Fixed some dialog lines puzzle related
 Maze randomness fix (easier)
 Menu updates


This little patch doesn't affect the gameplay at all, it cleans up some little bugs in dialogs and that mail box issue (for those who have experienced it), Mike walking is been slowed down a bit with different sound. Little tweak to Sullivan dialog part. I have fixed also the maze part (chapter 3), now should be a little bit easier to progress once you reach the maze.

Thanks all for playing my game! And if you like it please leave a good review! ːsteamhappyː
